QUOTE: "The scope is the whole repository, including nested git trees." and "A declared root is taken at its word and never walked. A nested clone under it is indexed without being noticed. `external.py` tags those rows afterwards so they stay distinguishable."
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer says nested git trees are included in the scope (indexed) and that `external.py` tags those rows rather than excluding them.
